description: Data for: A Complex Network Perspective for Characterizing Urban Travel Demand Patterns is a data set deposited in Mendeley Data by its authors Meead Saberi. The data contains information on the network structure of the origin-destination travel demand, including sampled trips by all modes, from Chicago, USA and Melbourne, Australia. Coverage: several countries (US, AU); the metadata date the deposit to 2019. The formats are not stated in the metadata. It is reached through its DOI or landing page, listed on this page. Access is free of charge and open according to the repository. The licence is Attribution-NonCommercial 3.0 Unported. Caveats: written from the DataCite metadata (title, abstract, subjects and rights) read on 2026-09-29; the deposit itself was not opened or downloaded, so its contents, quality and current availability were not checked. It can support transport-network, traffic and mobility studies. Related record: the repository-level record data-mendeley-repository.
